A live-action photograph: the first frame of one scene of a short drama, vertical composition, as a cinema camera records it on set. The people of the segment stand in their places at its start, in the place of Image 1, where Image 2 puts them and facing the way it shows. Natalie stands in the open bedroom doorway on the back wall in her ivory bridal gown and veil, with her pale-blue bag over her shoulder, facing into the bedroom. One round oak coffee table stands in front of the couch, between the couch and the window, with one blank white sheet of paper and one blue pen on it. One round dining table with two chairs stands between the couch and the kitchenette, near the bedroom door, and a white pillow lies on the dining chair nearer the couch.

Real adult faces with natural skin texture and pores, real fabric, natural light falloff and shadows, a slight film grain and the depth of field of a real lens, as in a frame of a live-action film.
